mapper.select: SELECT user_id, default_view, default_sort, reduce_motion, upload_concurrency, updated_at FROM user_preference WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_preference ( user_id, default_view, default_sort, reduce_motion, upload_concurrency, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{preference.userId}, #{preference.defaultView}, #{preference.defaultSort}, #{preference.reduceMotion}, #{preference.uploadConcurrency}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE default_view = VALUES(default_view), default_sort = VALUES(default_sort), reduce_motion = VALUES(reduce_motion), upload_concurrency = VALUES(upload_concurrency), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)
